_note: Composition recipes — playlists over features.json. A composition owns no footage; it selects features (by explicit `order`, or by `include`/`groupBy` rules) and applies per-video `settings`. One capture run feeds every composition. `settings.captions`: 'full' uses feature.render.caption, 'keyword' uses feature.title. `settings.zoom`: 'tight' keeps per-feature focus zooms; 'off' ignores them. Only `filmed: true` features can appear (render errors on a selected feature with no footage).
